# ROCKMEN R2 English Patch

**This is a machine translation. This code was generated by an AI.**

With that said...

# Prerequisites
HSPdecom, Lunar IPS, a hex editor, Python if you want to edit the translation

# Installation
1. Backup your game files (duh)
2. Run HSPdecom to extract start.ax from the exe. Please this extracted start.ax next to the exe.
3. Run lunar IPS and patch the start.ax so it can display more characters in English. Alternatively you can manually patch it with the instructions below.
4. Patch ROCKMEN R2.exe so it will load start.ax from disk (see below)
1. Rename your `hmm.dll` to `hmm_orig.dll`.
2. Drag and drop the files into the game folder
3. Pick the hmm dll you want from the patch and rename it to hmm.dll.
3. Play

hmm.dll hooks the file loading so it will prioritize external files before looking inside data.dpm.

# How did you do this?
Asked AI to write a decryptor for data.dpm, then asked AI to write a hook to load unpacked files, then asked AI to translate the script files, then asked AI to figure out the start.hsp and start.ax after realizing there aren't enough characters that can be printed when it's translated into English

## How to patch ROCKMEN R2 to load start.ax from disk
Open ROCKMEN R2.exe in your favorite hex editor, then press Ctrl+G and type `D7D14` and press Enter. The cursor should be placed on `00`. Type `48` and save.

(For programmers) The instruction at `0x420577` checks this

'H' -> first sig check matches -> eax!=0 -> embedded block skipped -> disk mode

## Patching start.ax to draw more characters and closer together

| What | Offset | Bytes now | Meaning |
| ---  | ------ | --------  | ------- |
| フルスクリーンで起動しますか？ | 0x225700 | ... | Enter Fullscreen? |
| Advance band 1 | 0x3CA00 | 04 40 14 00 00 00 | var_423 += 20 |
| Advance band 2 | 0x3CAEE | 04 40 14 00 00 00 | var_423 += 20 |
| Advance band 3 | 0x3CBDC | 04 40 14 00 00 00 | var_423 += 20 |
| Line char cap | 0x3C84C | 04 10 41 00 | repeat 65 |

(Hint: 20 in decimal is 14 in hexidecimal)

This is spacing out the drawn characters by 20 pixels, so we want to change this to something closer together. So for example if we pick 12, convert that to hex to get 0C and then we can replace 04 40 14 with 04 40 0C

Next we need to modify the number of characters that can be printed in a message box. The game is only truly capable of reading 100 bytes per line so we can only change that `41` to `64` (100 in hexidecimal is 64).

# Translating it yourself
1. Edit the text files in the "in" directory. Note that these have been converted to UTF-8 instead of Shift-JIS.
2. Run the python script to remap the english characters to Japanese ones. This is so the modified sprite map displays the correct characters. It also converts it back to Shift-JIS since this game expects Shift-JIS encoded files.
3. Place the files in the "out" directory next to the game.
